narrative:
Fee, commission and insurance income is planned at EUR 204M, up from EUR 187M — this is where Aktia's growth comes from. Fund Management alone contributes EUR 58M, supported by EUR 15.4B of AUM and net subscriptions of EUR 420M YTD.

The headwind is fee yield: the mix is shifting toward fixed income, pulling the average management-fee yield down to 0.62%. Volume growth has to outrun that compression. In Life, unit-linked premiums follow fund performance with a short lag, and risk & disability claims improved 3pp.

The agents recommend lifting Fund Management and Unit-Linked Savings on flow data, and a probability-weighted uplift for an institutional Nordic credit mandate in Helsinki.

signals.title: Aktia Fund Flows — Q3 Net Subscriptions
signals.excerpt: Net subscriptions of EUR 420M YTD, led by fixed income and the Nordic Micro Cap fund. Monthly fund savings agreements up 11% via the mobile app.

signals.title: Aktia Life — Solvency & Claims Update
signals.excerpt: Solvency ratio 178%; risk & disability claims ratio improved 3pp YoY. Unit-linked reserves tracking fund performance.

signals.title: Aktia Strategy 2026 — Efficiency & Wealth Growth
signals.excerpt: Board reconfirms financial targets: cost-to-income below 60% and ROE above 12%. Growth priority is wealth management; banking services to be developed through digital channels.
